\caption{\textbf{Gaussian versus voxel maps at fixed poses.}
All maps use RELION's refined poses, optics and mask and are scored against RELION-5's polished half-2 map.
Particle counts are in parentheses (the 500 include the 250), and bold marks the best of the maps from 250 particles.
Gaussian fit to voxel: Gaussians fitted to the 250-particle voxel map instead of the images (subset 1 only).
Voxel, best filter: the voxel map after the best of nine low-pass and blur filters, chosen after scoring.
Against the atomic model, the Gaussian map is also slightly finer in subsets 1--3 (FSC~0.5 at 7.08, 7.03 and 7.05\,\AA\ against 7.23, 7.05 and 7.16\,\AA).
Details in \suppref{sec:suppl:efficiency}.}
